text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Heading into the Tenno Sho (Spring), Rice 
Shower pushes herself into overtraining, 
wishing to become the "Blue Rose" for so 
many people.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower confessed her anxieties, 
saying she didn't want to let down the 
people who supported her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Zenno Rob Roy tells Rice Shower to consult 
someone, reminding her that even a "blue 
rose" cannot bloom alone.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Moved by Zenno Rob Roy's words, Rice 
Shower decided to rely on others.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower begged Mihono Bourbon, 
deciding to undergo the so-called "demon" 
training alongside her.
